coverage_gaps.Google AI Blog: The configured 20-entry feed was last dated October 13, with no window entries. Upstream category checks found one additional window article from its publication metadata; the collection step did not read its body. Local final-hour review found the feed older than known page entries and could not establish a complete dated category list.
coverage_gaps.Microsoft AI: The configured URL redirected to Source AI, whose static and rendered lists lacked dates; the old feed returned HTTP 410. Alternative feeds yielded one candidate but do not establish complete configured-entry coverage. Local access returned HTTP 403. Browser follow-up could read titles and links but not complete dates, so the source remained partial.
coverage_gaps.Qwen: The configured GitHub blog remains dated in 2025 and cannot establish no updates. Only the current research site’s first screen was rendered, without pagination or filters. Stale page-configuration records and empty retrieval were inconclusive. Model creation times and repository pushes are not announcements. Pagination and ModelScope checks remained incomplete.
coverage_gaps.通义实验室: The configured homepage was a platform/navigation page without dated news cards. Linked news and rendered changelog entries preceded the window; last-modified metadata was not treated as publication time. Local access did not establish a complete dated list or no final-hour additions.
coverage_gaps.DeepSeek: Upstream review separated API update sections, official news, harness pages, and repository prereleases from commits and rendering timestamps. October 17 change-log sections and three harness prereleases were retained as discovery records. The local incremental script did not cover this source, leaving browser follow-up needed for full final-hour coverage.
coverage_gaps.智谱 Z.ai: Upstream news and research pages showed older dates, with bodies unread and navigation dates not treated as announcements. Local access returned a product homepage mixed with older news, without a complete dated list.
coverage_gaps.阶跃星辰 StepFun: The rendered homepage stated weights were available but had no dated news stream. Supplemental repository and model timestamps were earlier than the upstream window; a day-level technical-blog boundary remained for review. Repository commits were not treated as announcements. Local access returned only an application shell, leaving the publication boundary incomplete.
coverage_gaps.UNESCO AI: Upstream card publication epochs yielded one candidate within its discovery window, with no October 17 or 18 cards. A conflicting data-date field and event dates were not treated as publication times. Bodies were not read. Local checks did not resolve the mixed dates or final-hour boundary.
coverage_gaps.OECD.AI: Upstream embedded date_gmt records yielded sixteen deduplicated Wonk articles, latest October 12, with bodies unread. Other date-like page values were not treated as article dates. Local review did not verify the final-hour range record by record.
coverage_gaps.Hugging Face Daily Papers: Upstream lists for October 15 and 16 yielded 172 deduplicated recommendations. October 17 and 18 lists were empty, and October 19 returned HTTP 400 as not yet generated. These responses were retained literally and do not establish no new papers or no changes elsewhere. Full texts were not read in collection; local checks retained the upstream weekday lists.
coverage_gaps.OpenReview: The homepage and venue directory were available, but neither announcements nor lists of open venues establish new submissions in the window. Submissions were not checked venue by venue by time.
coverage_gaps.GitHub Trending（日榜 + Python 日榜）: Upstream daily and Python snapshots retained 22 deduplicated repositories with API metadata. Sponsor links were removed and non-AI projects retained for editorial review. This is a ranking snapshot, not a new-release list. Local access could not reconstruct the list at exactly 06:00; upstream discoveries and API metadata are preserved.
coverage_gaps.36氪 AI 频道（逐篇核验原创与转载）: Upstream pagination retained 120 records, 100 in its discovery window, inspecting publication metadata, bylines, and opening/closing attribution to distinguish original, contributed, unclassified, and syndicated material. Bodies were not read in full during collection. Local review obtained thirty first-screen titles with relative dates but did not fully verify final-hour timestamps.
coverage_gaps.MiniMax·News & Updates: Upstream rendered cards were dated October 13 or earlier, with the latest card’s original publication timestamp separately checked. Bodies were not read in collection. Local and browser follow-up initially loaded navigation without a complete dated card list or pagination, so coverage remained partial.
coverage_gaps.TechCrunch: Upstream AI-category pages retained twelve window entries and excluded event/ticket promotions; collection did not read bodies. Selected articles were separately checked using precise dates. Day-level category cards did not establish complete final-hour list coverage.
coverage_gaps.Ars Technica: Upstream first-page timestamps yielded five window entries, with bodies unread and original versus syndicated status not determined in collection. Both local HTTP and signed-in browser access returned 403, leaving final-hour coverage and body review incomplete.
coverage_gaps.MIT Technology Review: Upstream topic-page and feed review retained one window candidate, with bodies unread in collection. Local access returned an application shell; browser follow-up did not load the article list, leaving final-hour coverage partial.
coverage_gaps.404 Media: Upstream homepage and pagination checks retained eleven window-day records without reading bodies or deleting non-AI entries from discovery. Local review preserved those discoveries and day-level cards, but did not establish exact final-hour boundaries.
